name: departing passenger mandatory sequence
value_or_rule: arrival -> check-in (counter, kiosk or pre-checked online) -> weight check (passenger + carry-on) -> security screening or access control -> waiting area -> walk to stand -> boarding; no bag drop; no border control
sections_pages: Feldhoff 2022 pp. 2-5 Fig. 3; Feldhoff and Soares Roque 2021 'Passenger processing'; NUAIR/NASA 2021 Sec. 5.1.1.1 pp. 61-63
model_use: Phase D station order
applicability: Generic vertiport; all-carry-on and domestic/Schengen assumption
limitation: Sources diverge on full security screening versus access control (both papers leave it to regulators); the choice is pending
proposed_target: model_dictionary new rule row; scenario_protocol 'processamento terminal'
d2_disposition: D2 and VAR-034: complete screening and mandatory carry-on check, with order pending; weight station excluded.

name: passenger weighing time
sections_pages: Feldhoff 2022 p. 5
model_use: weight-check station service time
limitation: Assumption stated by Feldhoff (2022), not measured
d2_disposition: Weighing station outside D2; retain historical evidence.

name: access control service time
sections_pages: Feldhoff and Soares Roque 2021 'Vertiport simulation'
model_use: VAR-005 when access control replaces full screening
applicability: Airport vertiport; access to manoeuvring area
limitation: Stated assumption without citation; not a screening time
d2_disposition: Full screening in VAR-005; see PAR-025.

name: carry-on baggage check service time
sections_pages: Feldhoff and Soares Roque 2021 'Vertiport simulation'
model_use: optional baggage dimension/mass check station
limitation: Stated assumption without citation; relation to weight check not specified by the authors
d2_disposition: Mandatory stage in VAR-028/PAR-028; author assumption in LIT-010.

name: walk holding area to gate door
sections_pages: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table 3 p. 14; Table A1 B1/B6 pp. 19-20
model_use: passenger movement between waiting area and stand
limitation: Point value from 3 experts; depends on layout; replace by distance/speed when layout is fixed
d2_disposition: VAR-024/PAR-022; point estimate as constant.

name: enter gate (door to aircraft proximity)
sections_pages: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table 3 p. 14; Table A1 B2 p. 20
model_use: component of boarding sequence before PAR-008
limitation: Point value from 5 experts; no distribution
d2_disposition: VAR-024/PAR-023; point estimate as constant.

name: leave gate after deboarding
sections_pages: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table 3 p. 14; Table A1 B5 p. 20
model_use: component of deboarding sequence after PAR-009
limitation: Point value from 2 experts; low confidence
d2_disposition: VAR-024/PAR-024; point estimate as constant.

name: boarding completion event
value_or_rule: boarding of a passenger ends when the passenger is buckled up and ready for take-off; deboarding starts when the passenger unbuckles
sections_pages: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table A1 B3/B4 p. 20; Reg. (EU) 2024/1111 UAM.OP.MVCA.225(b)(1) pp. 46-47
model_use: timestamp definition for W_pax end and for R_ready
limitation: Definition only; the 73.0 s and 65.8 s values already in PAR-008/009; regulation requires belts secured before taxiing, consistent with the event
d2_disposition: Start of individual boarding ends VAR-012; end is used in VAR-022.

name: station LoS maximum waiting times (IATA ADRM time criterion)
value_or_rule: counter check-in 180; self-service check-in 120; security screening 180; weight check 180 (Optimum upper bound)
sections_pages: Feldhoff 2022 pp. 8-9 Tables 5-6
model_use: LoS by station: share of passengers waiting above the maximum (NALoS)
limitation: IATA ADRM values as reproduced by Feldhoff 2022 (ADRM not read directly); weight-check value set by the author; alternative economy x 0.167 set gives 200;20;100; choice of set pending; space criterion not modelled; LoS is not satisfaction
d2_disposition: PAR-026 adopts Table 5 counter/kiosk/security; Table 6 alternative only proposed in PAR-031. No weight station.

name: aircraft passenger readiness sequence
value_or_rule: arrival at stand -> deplaning complete and passengers clear of airside -> servicing (charging only if required) -> crew confirms aircraft ready for boarding -> gate opens (status = boarding) -> boarding complete -> system check -> operator dispatch -> departure slot revalidated
model_use: state machine for stand and departure readiness
applicability: Scheduled base case and FCFS benchmark
limitation: ConOps prescription for automated operations; durations not provided
d2_disposition: VAR-022 uses declared duration from scenario, no energy trigger; gate readiness before boarding.

name: mass declaration before departure
value_or_rule: departure readiness requires mass of every boarded passenger and carry-on registered on the load sheet (weight-and-balance before every flight)
sections_pages: Reg. (EU) 2024/1111 UAM.OP.MVCA.175(b)(1) and (10) p. 45; Feldhoff and Soares Roque 2021; ICAO Doc 10121 6.3.2 p. 6-6; Feldhoff 2022 pp. 3-4
model_use: justifies mandatory weight-check station and a readiness prerequisite
limitation: The regulation requires the PIC to be satisfied on mass and CG before flight; it does not prescribe a weighing station, so weighing versus declared mass remains a process choice
proposed_target: model_dictionary rule row linked to PC-01
d2_disposition: Mass and CG remain documented context; no weigh station or load-sheet variables in current model.

name: no charging while passengers embark/on board/disembark
value_or_rule: base case: no charging or swapping while passengers embark, are on board or disembark; overlap allowed only as a later scenario that assumes operator SOPs from a risk assessment and a training programme
sections_pages: Reg. (EU) 2024/1111 UAM.OP.MVCA.205 p. 46 (verbatim); EASA CRD 2022-06 pp. 89-90 and 106-107
model_use: charging/passenger exclusion at stand
applicability: Electric VTOL-capable aircraft under EU rules
limitation: The rule permits overlap under conditions; the base-case non-overlap is a scope decision already recorded in D2, not a regulatory prohibition
proposed_target: confirms D2 decision; no dictionary change
d2_disposition: Base case does not overlap charging and passengers; battery swap excluded.

name: battery swap excluded from base case
value_or_rule: inclusion of battery swap in the base case: decision pending (author)
sections_pages: Reg. (EU) 2024/1111 UAM.OP.MVCA.205 p. 46; EASA CRD 2022-06 p. 90; NREL 2023 p. vi
model_use: PAR-011 status
limitation: Facts only: the adopted rule contemplates swapping (also with passengers, under SOP and training); CRD characterises swap as maintenance; NREL-surveyed OEMs do not plan swapping; Eve/Joby 10-K filings do not mention it
d2_disposition: PAR-011 records author exclusion.

name: energy readiness for departure
value_or_rule: an aircraft is not dispatched unless usable energy covers taxi + trip + contingency + final reserve (+ additional + extra) for the next flight; charging is triggered only when this fails
sections_pages: Reg. (EU) 2024/1111 UAM.OP.VCA.191(c) pp. 40-41 and UAM.OP.MVCA.175(b)(7) p. 45; NREL 2023 p. 53
model_use: charging need condition in Phase C
limitation: Structure is regulatory; every term needs AFM consumption and go-around data not published for Eve or Joby, so the numeric threshold stays undefined
proposed_target: VAR-008 basis; new VAR for SOC threshold (undefined)
d2_disposition: Energy of mission outside current model; historical regulatory context only.

name: charging declared in reservation
value_or_rule: charging need and its duration are declared in the flight plan/reservation; performed in situ at stand/parking or after repositioning, with repositioning time added to the reservation
sections_pages: NUAIR/NASA 2021 Sec. 5.1.1.6.4 p. 73; PTS-VPT-DSN p. 18 and C.200(f) p. 25; NREL 2023 pp. 19-20
model_use: maps directly to VAR-021 categories (stand / adjacent dedicated) and to scheduled admission VAR-018
limitation: No duration values
d2_disposition: Declare service duration for scenarios; stand proposed first and dedicated case requires VAR-038.

name: charger queue discipline
sections_pages: NREL 2023 pp. 55-56 and p. 110
model_use: charger allocation when c_charge >= 1
limitation: NREL chose FCFS for least coordination and notes managed charging can increase throughput
d2_disposition: NREL treatment may inform charger queue; local policy specified in scenario protocol and operational rules remain pending.

name: peak DC charging power envelope
sections_pages: NREL 2023 p. vi and pp. 12-13
model_use: only published charger power range; use in the model pending
limitation: Not Eve/Joby specific; no charge curve; must not be converted into a charge duration without OEM energy data
d2_disposition: PAR-027 and PAR-010 retained for provenance; declaration of duration in PAR-002.

name: vertistop no-local-charging scenario
value_or_rule: scenario class where only deboarding/boarding occur at the stand and no charger exists
sections_pages: NREL 2023 p. 1; Schweiger and Preis 2022 pp. 4-5 and 31; NUAIR/NASA 2021 p. 41
model_use: keeps 'absent' as a VAR-021 level
limitation: Not regulatory: the no-charging vertistop definition came from the FAA EB 105 draft and EB 105A treats vertistops as vertiports for design (p. 3)
d2_disposition: Zero-duration scenario without local charge per VAR-008/021, no regulatory prohibition inferred.

name: aircraft unavailable at departure
value_or_rule: if aircraft needs minor maintenance, enplaning passengers are held in the terminal until it is released; if no substitute aircraft exists the flight is cancelled and passengers are re-accommodated
sections_pages: NUAIR/NASA 2021 Sec. 5.1.1.6.1 p. 71
model_use: off-nominal scenario only
limitation: No probabilities or durations
d2_disposition: Off-nominal transfer candidate outside core protocol.

name: analytic throughput upper bound
value_or_rule: min(mu_TLOF, mu_taxi, mu_G) with mu_G = C_G / TAT_min and mu_TLOF from pad occupancy time
sections_pages: Saxena et al. 2025 Secs. 4.1-4.4 Eqs. 26-29 pp. 14-16
model_use: verification check: DES throughput must not exceed the bound in unblocked cases (D2 method step 1)
limitation: Ideal deterministic bound with immediate refilling; preprint
d2_disposition: Use bounds only for matched resources and counts; Phase A uses single-resource closed form.

name: gate departure order
value_or_rule: among aircraft at stands, the one whose boarding completes first is ready to leave first (subject to slot)
sections_pages: Saxena et al. 2025 Sec. 3.1.1 p. 6; NUAIR/NASA 2021 Sec. 5.1.1.2 p. 64
model_use: tie-break for stand release when several aircraft are ready
limitation: Modelling assumption in a preprint; base case has one stand
d2_disposition: Possible multi-stand tie-break outside unitary scenario.
